note: 새로 생성한 서울 모티프의 장식 일러스트다. 평면 지도 위 일부 산·아파트·남산타워만 입체로 표현하고 지도 외곽을 흐림·투명 페이드 처리했다. 사진 카드도 AI 생성한 골목·카페·주택가 장면이며 실제 사용자 사진이나 지도 캡처를 사용하지 않았다. 실제 Explore 지도와 핀은 변경하지 않는다.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: replacement marketing illustration for a calm Korean travel-photo archive, landscape 1536x1024 (3:2), transparent alpha background. Primary request: A simplified TWO-DIMENSIONAL Seoul-inspired street map, viewed at a gentle oblique tilt, with only a few small 3D landmarks rising from the otherwise flat map. This is a flat map graphic, NOT a miniature city diorama, NOT a floating thick map slab, NOT a raised island. Quiet pale ivory/white road network and city-block outlines, sparse soft sage park areas and a subtle blue-green river. The flat map spreads broadly across almost the whole canvas and gradually loses detail, softens, blurs and fades to fully transparent at ALL outer edges. Irregular feathered perimeter, no hard rectangular boundary, no visible map-board thickness, no strong cast shadow. The gentle atmospheric edge fade should visually blend into a white website banner and feel spacious yet full even with sparse details. Center stays clean and readable, not globally blurred. Exactly one small simplified N Seoul Tower, one small rounded green hill and a sparse group of simple apartment blocks are occasional 3D accents, not a dense city model. Exactly three ordinary deep-teal teardrop location pins at three separated SMALL LOCAL PLACES. Above these pins float three elegant slim white-framed realistic travel-photo cards: one quiet Korean brick alley with warm late-afternoon light, one tiny neighborhood cafe exterior with potted plants and a seat by its window, and one charming narrow residential lane with steps and soft greenery. These are intimate hidden spots, NOT famous-landmark photos, NO skyline or tower photos, no palace photographs, no people, no identifiable real businesses or legible signs. One card is slightly larger, the others smaller; keep all three frames and their pin connections crisp and fully visible. Thin understated stems connect each card to its own pin, no oversized UI. Overall refined lightweight cartographic editorial illustration with only selective small 3D details. Palette: warm ivory #f9f7f2, white, restrained deep teal #1a4d4e, quiet sage and soft blue-green, low saturation, gentle daylight. The map should occupy the background naturally rather than read as a hard-edged object placed on it. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, map controls, leaf-shaped pins or heavy dark base. Original illustration using generic modern web-map visual language, not a screenshot or copy of any proprietary map. No text or webpage composition.

delivery.conversion: Sharp resize to 1152px, WebP quality 82 / effort 6; no content edits outside image_gen
